question: What kind of seven-syllabled formulation is said to extend from rasa through the white dhātu?
premises: A dhātu range from rasa to white is named.
That is described as endowed with seven syllables.
The phrase qualifies a mantra/formulation in context.
inference: A seven-syllabled formulation is specified as spanning from rasa up to the white dhātu.
uncertainties: Whether dhātu means bodily elements here follows common mantra-context usage but is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: (A mantra) from rasa to the white dhātu, endowed with seven syllables.
